sourceText:
Sun Dried Tomato Spread
By: Shoppeatgwens
Published: Saturday, August 21, 2010 - 5:20pm

Ingredients




1 package Cream Cheese – softened
1/4 cup Sun Dried Tomatoes, Chopped
1/4 cup Chives – rough chopped
10 Good Size (Large) Croutons
1/4 cup Pecans
2 cloves of Garlic
4 tablespoons Olive Oil
Salt& Pepper

Preparation

1 In Food Processor, add garlic and pecans. Pulse till crumbly. Add Croutons and pulse again till crumbly. 2 Add chives and sun dried tomatoes & salt and pepper till pureed.  3 Add cream cheese and pulse till spread comes together in a ball.  4 Add olive oil till spread becomes smooth.
 5 Serve with crackers
